author: ETA PRIME
description:
In this video we take a look at and test out the RG56 Pro Max. This retro handheld features a 5.5-inch IPS display, Hall-based sticks, and runs EmuELEC on a Rockchip 3562, the pricing on sites like Amazon is all over the place. Is it worth it at the $65 sweet spot? Yes. Should you pay $100 for it? Definitely not.
This device is capable of emulating a wide variety of retro consoles and arcade boards, Like: Sega Dreamcast, Neo Geo, Sega Mega Drive, MSX, Capcom Play System 1, Capcom Play System 3, Capcom Play System 2, Nintendo Game Boy, Nintendo Game Boy Advance, Nintendo Game Boy Color, Nintendo Entertainment System, Nintendo DS, Nintendo 64, PlayStation Portable, Sega NAOMI, and Multiple Arcade Machine Emulator (MAME)
